query:
-- GA-1: Jim Kingston won R primary; D primary going to runoff (Griggs vs Hollowell, June 16)
UPDATE house_races SET 
  candidate2_name = 'Jim Kingston',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  status = 'Primary Runoff',
  candidate1_name = 'Joyce Griggs → A. Hollowell (D Runoff, June 16)'
WHERE state_code = 'GA' AND district = '1';

-- GA-5: Nikema Williams (D) won primary; J. Salvesen is the R candidate (not Arnetress Beatty who was D primary challenger)
UPDATE house_races SET 
  candidate1_name = 'Nikema Williams',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'J. Salvesen',
  candidate2_party = 'R'
WHERE state_code = 'GA' AND district = '5';

-- GA-7: D primary going to runoff (Kozycki vs Norton, June 16); R candidate is McCormick
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'Primary Runoff',
  candidate1_name = 'T. Kozycki → C. Norton (D Runoff, June 16)'
WHERE state_code = 'GA' AND district = '7';

SELECT state_code, district, status, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party 
FROM house_races WHERE state_code = 'GA' ORDER BY district;
